template: Keep the scene exactly as in the first frame. Static, locked-off CCTV camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts. The containment doors are sliding doors that slide sideways along the top track; never show hinged or swinging doors. {action} End on the last frame. Realistic security-camera footage, natural walking speed, 8 seconds.

clips.action: A technician in a dark polo shirt and lanyard walks up to the doors, slides the left door open, walks into the aisle and slides the door shut behind them.

clips.timeline_hint: closed -> passing (ends open, person still moving away)
clips.action: A technician pushes a grey equipment cart up to the doors, slides both doors open and pushes the cart through into the aisle, continuing down the aisle away from the doors.
A technician carrying a cardboard box slides the left door open, sets the box down in the door's track so it holds the door open, then walks away out of frame.
A technician pushes a grey equipment cart into the doorway so its handlebar blocks the left door, leaves it there and walks out of frame.
A technician slides the left door open, picks up a red fire extinguisher and stands it in the door's track to hold the door open, then walks away out of frame.
A technician walks out of the aisle through the left door and away out of frame without closing it; the door slides back but stops about 30 cm short of closing.
A technician walks out of the aisle through the doors and away out of frame; the doors slide back but leave a narrow gap of about 10 cm.
One technician slides the left door open and holds it while a second technician walks through into the aisle; the first follows and the door is slid shut.
A technician walks up from the corridor, picks up the cardboard box from the door track and slides the door shut, then walks away out of frame.

clips.timeline_hint: propped throughout (person busy inside, never passes through)
clips.action: The door stays propped open by the box. The technician inside the aisle stays at the rack, checking a server and writing notes on a clipboard, then takes a phone call while standing still. Nobody walks through the doorway.
